entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'd like to start a return for my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I received it about two weeks ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, could you tell me a bit more about the issue? Is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference issue?
It's more of a preference thing. To be honest, I've found it quite confusing and hard to use. I really expected more based on the reviews.
I see. I'm sorry to hear it hasn't been a smooth experience for you. What specifically have you found confusing about it? Sometimes the setup can have a tricky step or two.

Well, the main problem is that I can't seem to see my live cadence data while I'm actually riding. I've looked through the user manual, but it just seems to show up in the summary after my workout is over, which isn't what I wanted it for.

Ah, that's a fantastic question and a very common point of confusion. You're right, that feature isn't enabled by default. We can fix that in about 30 seconds. Do you have your phone with the VeloFit app handy?
Yes, I have it right here.
Great. Go ahead and open the VeloFit app. From the home screen, tap on 'Equipment,' then select 'Customize Ride Screen.' You should see a layout of your current ride data. Is that what you see?
Okay... yep, I'm on that screen now. I see speed and heart rate.

Perfect. Below that, there should be a list of 'Available Data Fields.' Just find 'Live Cadence' in that list, press and hold it, and then drag it into one of the empty slots on your ride screen layout.
Oh! Wow, there it is. I just dragged it up. So now it will show up when I start a ride?
That's exactly right. It will now display your real-time cadence just like your speed. I'm glad we could sort that out. Is there anything else that's been causing trouble?

No, that was the main thing. I feel a bit silly for not finding it. Now that it's working, I'll definitely keep it. Listen, since I did spend a fair bit of time being frustrated and was about to go through the whole return process, would you be able to offer a small credit or a discount code for my trouble?

I completely understand the frustration, and I appreciate you giving us the chance to make it right. While our policy doesn't allow for credits or discounts in this type of situation, I have made a detailed note on your account regarding the user manual. We'll pass that feedback directly to our documentation team to make that feature easier to find for future customers.
Okay, I suppose that's fair. I appreciate you taking the feedback. And thank you for walking me through the fix. You've saved me a trip to the post office.
You're very welcome! I'm happy I could help you get the most out of your VeloBand. Enjoy your next ride with that live data! Thanks for calling VeloFit.
